residual_assessment.precise_problem: How can a signed but fallible human H endpoint calibrate an objective marker without defining H by report, success, fluency or route telemetry, and under what premise can it be used in a no-report domain?
residual_assessment.net_increment_after_subtraction: A UCT-specific semantic calibration firewall: arbitrary unsigned proxy batteries retain H-complement symmetry; an independent signed endpoint orients only its calibration domain; class-conditional transport and actual-use grounding are separately required; a formation-by-use interaction is a falsifiable bridge test but not identification.
residual_assessment.next_specific_action: Run or design a reporting-adult pilot with predeclared comparative H judgment, response-key reversal, success/fluency control, actual route bypass and held-out signed-marker validation.

warning: Label symmetry, measurement invariance and factorial-confounding mathematics are prior work; absence of the exact UCT interface synthesis from checked sources is not worldwide priority.
